W: 好的。您想了解什么?
M: 嗯,我邻居大概一年前在他屋顶上装了太阳能板
W: 嗯,我不了解您邻居的情况或他的具体配置
M: 好的,那听起来差不多
W: 先生,您有兴趣在您的屋顶上安装太阳能板吗?
W: 如果您愿意来我们办公室

items.stem: What does the news report say about the waiter?

choices.text: He wanted to buy a home.
choices.zh: 他想买房。

choices.text: He suffered from a shock.
choices.zh: 他遭受了震惊。

choices.text: He lost a huge sum of money.
choices.zh: 他损失了一大笔钱。

choices.text: He did an unusual good deed.
choices.zh: 他做了一件不同寻常的好事。

items.stem: What did the customer try to do when she got her check back?

choices.text: Invite the waiter to a fancy dinner.
choices.zh: 邀请这位服务员去高档餐厅用餐。

choices.text: Tell her story to the Daily News.
choices.zh: 把她的故事告诉《每日新闻》。

choices.text: Give some money to the waiter.
choices.zh: 给这位服务员一些钱。

choices.text: Pay the waiter's school tuition.
choices.zh: 支付这位服务员的学费。

items.stem: What is Maref's vote on Tuesday about?

choices.text: Whether or not to move to the state's mainland.
choices.zh: 是否搬迁到该州的大陆。

choices.text: How to keep the village from sinking into the sea.
choices.zh: 如何防止村庄沉入海中。

choices.text: Where to get the funds for rebuilding their village.
choices.zh: 从哪里获得重建村庄的资金。

choices.text: What to do about the rising level of the seawater.
choices.zh: 如何应对海平面上升的问题。

items.stem: Why did Donna Barr say they wouldn't see the plan carried out any time soon?

choices.text: It takes too long a time.
choices.zh: 需要太长时间。

choices.text: It costs too much money.
choices.zh: 花费太多资金。

choices.text: It has to wait for the state's final approval.
choices.zh: 必须等待州政府的最终批准。

choices.text: It faces strong opposition from many villagers.
choices.zh: 面临许多村民的强烈反对。

items.stem: What is the purpose of the social experiment?

choices.text: To investigate whether people are grateful for help.
choices.zh: 调查人们是否对帮助心存感激。

choices.text: To see whether people hold doors open for strangers.
choices.zh: 看人们是否会为陌生人扶门。

choices.text: To explore ways of inducing gratitude in people.
choices.zh: 探索激发人们感恩之心的方法。

choices.text: To find out how people express gratitude.
choices.zh: 弄清人们如何表达感激之情。

items.stem: What did Steve Foran and his team do in the experiment?

choices.text: They induced strangers to talk with them.
choices.zh: 他们引导陌生人与他们交谈。

choices.text: They helped 15 to 20 people in a bad mood.
choices.zh: 他们帮助了15到20个心情不好的人。

choices.text: They held doors open for people at various places.
choices.zh: 他们在不同地点为人们扶门。

choices.text: They interviewed people who didn't say thank you.
choices.zh: 他们采访了没有说谢谢的人。

items.stem: What do we learn from the news report?

choices.text: People can be educated to be grateful.
choices.zh: 人们可以被教育得懂感恩。

choices.text: Most people express gratitude for help.
choices.zh: 大多数人会对帮助表达感激。

choices.text: Most people have bad days now and then.
choices.zh: 大多数人时不时会有糟糕的日子。

choices.text: People are ungrateful when in a bad mood.
choices.zh: 人们在心情不好时不懂感恩。

items.stem: What is the man's purpose for calling the woman?

choices.text: To order a solar panel installation.
choices.zh: 订购太阳能电池板安装服务。

choices.text: To report a serious leak in his roof.
choices.zh: 报告他屋顶有严重漏水。

choices.text: To enquire about solar panel installations.
choices.zh: 咨询太阳能电池板安装事宜。

choices.text: To complain about the faulty solar panels.
choices.zh: 投诉有问题的太阳能电池板。

items.stem: What do we learn about the man's neighbor from the conversation?

choices.text: He plans to install solar panels.
choices.zh: 他计划安装太阳能电池板。

choices.text: He owns a four-bedroom house.
choices.zh: 他拥有一栋四居室房屋。

choices.text: He saves $300 a year.
choices.zh: 他每年节省300美元。

choices.text: He has a large family.
choices.zh: 他有一个大家庭。

items.stem: What is one of the man's chief concerns?

choices.text: The service of the solar panel company.
choices.zh: 太阳能电池板公司的服务。

choices.text: The cost of a solar panel installation.
choices.zh: 太阳能电池板安装的费用。

choices.text: The maintenance of the solar panels.
choices.zh: 太阳能电池板的维护。

choices.text: The quality of the solar panels.
choices.zh: 太阳能电池板的质量。

items.stem: How long will it take a typical household to make back the initial investment?

choices.text: One year and a half.
choices.zh: 一年半。

choices.text: Less than four years.
choices.zh: 不到四年。

choices.text: Roughly six years.
choices.zh: 大约六年。

choices.text: About five years.
choices.zh: 大约五年。

items.stem: Where is the conversation taking place?

choices.text: At a travel agency.
choices.zh: 在旅行社。

choices.text: At an Australian airport.
choices.zh: 在澳大利亚的机场。

choices.text: At an airline transfer service.
choices.zh: 在航空公司中转服务处。

choices.text: At a local transportation authority.
choices.zh: 在当地交通管理局。

items.stem: Why is the woman interested in package holidays?

choices.text: She would be able to visit more scenic spots.
choices.zh: 她能够游览更多景点。

choices.text: She wanted to save as much money as possible.
choices.zh: 她想尽可能多地省钱。

choices.text: She would like to have everything taken care of.
choices.zh: 她希望一切都有人安排妥当。

choices.text: She wanted to spend more time with her family.
choices.zh: 她想和家人度过更多时间。

items.stem: How long does the woman want to go for the holiday?

choices.text: Four days.
choices.zh: 四天。

choices.text: Five days.
choices.zh: 五天。

choices.text: One week.
choices.zh: 一周。

choices.text: Two weeks.
choices.zh: 两周。

items.stem: What does the woman say she likes about the holiday package?

choices.text: Choosing some activities herself.
choices.zh: 自己选择一些活动。

choices.text: Spending Christmas with Australians.
choices.zh: 与澳大利亚人一起过圣诞节。

choices.text: Driving along the Great Ocean Road.
choices.zh: 沿着大洋路自驾。

choices.text: Learning more about wine making.
choices.zh: 更多地了解葡萄酒酿造。

items.stem: What would tourists have to do when they visit Indonesia's Bali Island?

choices.text: Bring their own bags when shopping.
choices.zh: 购物时自带购物袋。

choices.text: Use public transport when traveling.
choices.zh: 旅行时使用公共交通。

choices.text: Dispose of their trash properly.
choices.zh: 妥善处理自己的垃圾。

choices.text: Pay a green tax upon arrival.
choices.zh: 抵达时缴纳绿色税。

items.stem: What does the passage say about Indonesia?

choices.text: It has not been doing a good job in recycling.
choices.zh: 它在回收利用方面做得不好。

choices.text: It has witnessed a rise in accidental drowning.
choices.zh: 它目睹了意外溺水事件的增加。

choices.text: It has not attracted many tourists in recent years.
choices.zh: 近年来它没有吸引很多游客。

choices.text: It has experienced an overall decline in air quality.
choices.zh: 它经历了空气质量的整体下降。

items.stem: What is the new plan Governor Koster recently announced?

choices.text: To charge a small fee on plastic products in supermarkets.
choices.zh: 对超市里的塑料产品收取小额费用。

choices.text: To ban single-use plastic bags and straws on Bali Island.
choices.zh: 禁止在巴厘岛使用一次性塑料袋和吸管。

choices.text: To promote the use of paper bags for shopping.
choices.zh: 推广使用纸袋购物。

choices.text: To impose a penalty on anyone caught littering.
choices.zh: 对任何被抓到乱扔垃圾的人处以罚款。

items.stem: What do we learn from the passage about the North Atlantic right whale?

choices.text: It gives birth to several babies at a time.
choices.zh: 它一次产下几头幼崽。

choices.text: It is the least protected mammal species.
choices.zh: 它是受保护程度最低的哺乳动物物种。

choices.text: It's breeding grounds are now better preserved.
choices.zh: 它的繁殖地现在得到了更好的保护。

choices.text: It's population is now showing signs of increase.
choices.zh: 它的种群数量现在显示出增长的迹象。

items.stem: What has caused the decline of the whale population in recent years?

choices.text: Global warming.
choices.zh: 全球变暖。

choices.text: Polluted seawaters.
choices.zh: 海水污染。

choices.text: Commercial hunting.
choices.zh: 商业捕猎。

choices.text: Decreasing birthrates.
choices.zh: 出生率下降。

items.stem: Why do the whales travel to the Northeast Coast of America in the early spring?

choices.text: To mate.
choices.zh: 交配。

choices.text: To look for food.
choices.zh: 寻找食物。

choices.text: To escape hunters.
choices.zh: 逃避捕猎者。

choices.text: To seek breeding grounds.
choices.zh: 寻找繁殖地。

items.stem: What does the passage say about Americans?

choices.text: They prefer to drink low-fat milk.
choices.zh: 他们更喜欢喝低脂牛奶。

choices.text: They think milk is good for health.
choices.zh: 他们认为牛奶有益健康。

choices.text: They consume less milk these days.
choices.zh: 他们如今消耗的牛奶更少了。

choices.text: They buy more milk than the British.
choices.zh: 他们购买的牛奶比英国人多。

items.stem: How do Americans and British people think of milk nowadays?

choices.text: It is not as healthy as once thought.
choices.zh: 它不像曾经认为的那样健康。

choices.text: It is not easy to stay fresh for long.
choices.zh: 它不容易长时间保持新鲜。

choices.text: It benefits the elderly more.
choices.zh: 它对老年人更有益。

choices.text: It tends to make people fat.
choices.zh: 它往往使人发胖。

items.stem: Why does drinking milk cause pain in some people?

choices.text: They drink too many pints every day.
choices.zh: 他们每天喝太多品脱的牛奶。

choices.text: They are sensitive to certain minerals.
choices.zh: 他们对某些矿物质敏感。

choices.text: They lack the necessary proteins to digest it.
choices.zh: 他们缺乏消化牛奶所需的蛋白质。

choices.text: They have eaten food incompatible with milk.
choices.zh: 他们吃了与牛奶不相容的食物。

items.stem: What does the passage say is a benefit of milk?

choices.text: It is easier for sick people to digest.
choices.zh: 病人更容易消化它。

choices.text: It provides some necessary nutrients.
choices.zh: 它提供一些必需的营养素。

choices.text: It is healthier than other animal products.
choices.zh: 它比其他动物产品更健康。

choices.text: It supplies the body with enough calories.
choices.zh: 它为身体提供足够的卡路里。
